printed_witness.finding: The aru affix is kit. The witness gives kuṭaru in the tent sense and leaves the purpose of kit for investigation.
The witness names farmer, Yama and the Māgha citation. It says the effect of the k marker is not seen.

restricted_inference.domain: kuṭ in kuṭādi, primary 06.0093, affix aru with neither ñ nor ṇ as a marker
restricted_inference.unsettled: Whether the explicit marker has another effect or is needed in another lexical history. No claim of global dispensability.
